[b]Installation:[/b]
1. Backup your default files.
2. Unzip the file.
3. Place the Content folder into your Stardew Valley folder, overwriting everything it asks you to.
[i]If you're using Steam, the default folder path is something like C:\Program Files\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley.[/i]

[b]Uninstallation:[/b]
1. Delete the files.
2. Restore the backups you made.
